text: IDEA Git 是面向 DSH Web 的 IDEA 风格 Git 工作台。它通过 Cordis bundle 注册 Host 端 RPC，并在浏览器侧栏和主区域添加完整工作面板。用户可查看提交图与提交详情、浏览差异和文件历史、注解代码行，并管理本地更改、暂存、分支、标签和 Stash。适合希望在 DSH Web 中直接处理 Git 仓库的开发者。需要本机 Git 可用；代码未显示额外 API 密钥或外部服务要求。

IDEA Git is a Git workbench for DSH Web, adding a browser sidebar panel backed by a host RPC route. It lets developers review commits and diffs, annotate files, and manage local changes, branches, tags, and stashes. Local Git is required.
想在 DSH 的网页界面里查看和管理 Git 提交、分支与本地更改。
有没有能并排看代码差异并暂存选中改动的 DSH 插件？
I want to review commit history, diffs, and file blame in my DSH web workspace.
IDEA Git 的功能「Git 仓库工作台」：在 DSH Web 侧栏打开主工作区，查看提交日志、差异和仓库文件状态，并操作提交、分支及 Stash。通过界面选择 Git 操作，结果在工作台中呈现。

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · IDEA Git：An IntelliJ IDEA-style Git workbench for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It adds a **Git** icon to the sidebar and opens a full central panel rather than a small widget.

> After installing or updating the bundle, refresh the Harness page once so the browser loads the latest Client half. The Host half activates immediately.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · What it brings from IDEA：- **Readable commit graph** — colored lanes, merge curves, ref labels, HEAD emphasis and virtualized rows.
- **Log** — branch/remote/tag tree, multi-ref filtering, search, author/path/date filters, first-parent mode and incremental loading.
- **Commit details** — subject and body, author/committer, parents, refs, first-parent changed files with a collapsible directory tree and per-file diff.
- **Diff viewer** — side-by-side and unified modes, intra-line word highlighting, ignore-whitespace, file navigation, binary/large-file handling, and **selective hunk staging** straight from the working-tree and index diffs, with a fine-grained (zero-context) mode that splits nearby changes into separately stageable hunks.
- **Local Changes** — staged/unstaged/conflicted/untracked groups, per-file and per-hunk staging, discard with confirmation, commit/amend/sign-off, and commit & push.
- **File history** — rename-following history for any tracked file, with a searchable file tree.
- **Annotate (blame)** — per-line authors with colors, revision input, "annotate previous revision", and commit details beside the source.
- **Stash** — create,

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · AI attribution: how it works：Git has no concept of "which AI wrote this", so the plugin records it the git-native way — trailers — and displays whatever the repository already carries.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · AI attribution: how it works：Both stamping paths are configurable (see below); display cannot be disabled because it only reads what is already in the repository.

The agent field names (`id`, `options.model`, `options.provider`, `session.header.cwd`) were confirmed against a live `Agent` object in this Harness (0.2.1-rc.2) with a temporary read-only probe, and every read is guarded so a different shape degrades to the fallback instead of throwing.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Configuration：The bundle row accepts three fields (see `cordis.patch.yml`); all default to the values shown.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `stampAttribution` | `true` | Append the `Assisted-by` trailer to commits this panel creates. |
| `agentCommitHint` | `true` | Register the prompt section that asks agents to stamp their own commits. |
| `attributionKey` | `Assisted-by` | Trailer key used when stamping. |

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Known limits：IDEA features that need an editor surface (gutter blame, jump-to-source), rebase `reword` with inline message editing, drag-and-drop rebase ordering, changelists and Local History are intentionally out of scope for this panel.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Known limits：Two attribution caveats worth knowing: when no live agent is working in the repository the stamp falls back to the *default* model selection (and says so in the value), and a commit made by the agent in a terminal is only traceable if that agent honoured the prompt-section request.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Safety：- Git is always invoked with an argv array, never through a shell.
- Refs, hashes, branch names and paths are validated before use; path arguments follow `--`.
- Interactive prompts, pagers and editors are disabled (`GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`, `GIT_PAGER=cat`, `GIT_EDITOR=:`).
- Destructive actions (discard, hard reset, delete branch, drop stash, checkout revision) ask for confirmation.
- The plugin exposes one authenticated Host route; browser requests use the Harness connection trust fence.

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Layout：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host plugin: authenticated web route, workspace discovery, RPC dispatch |
| `git-core.js` | Git execution, validation and parsers (plain Node ESM, unit-tested) |
| `client.js` | Browser half: slot registration, locale, graph, diff and all views |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the Host row |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin Manager title and description |

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Keyboard：- `F5` refresh
- `Ctrl/Cmd+Enter` commit from the message box
- `Up/Down` move through the log; `Enter` opens the first changed file
- `Esc` closes a diff, menu, popover or dialog

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Development checks：The runtime has no dependencies beyond the Harness; every check below uses only Node.js and Git. Three of them run against a demo repository, which is **generated rather than committed** (a nested `.git` inside this one would become a gitlink instead of a usable fixture):

```powershell
node test-make-demo.mjs ..\idea-git-demo   # create the fixture: branches, merge, tag, stash, dirty tree
```

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · Development checks：```powershell
node test-release.mjs                     # release checklist: manifest, files, locale, icon, patch, syntax
node test-client-load.mjs                  # bundle syntax + slot/locale registration
node test-host-route.mjs                   # authenticated route, workspace scan, RPC + real git
node test-smoke.mjs ../idea-git-demo       # git engine read/write/rename/binary/stash/conflict/hunk/trailer checks
node test-rebase.mjs                       # interactive rebase plan (pick/squash/drop)

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · npm install --no-save --prefix .tmp-test react@18.3.1 react-test-renderer@18.3.1：node test-render-hunks.mjs                 # selective hunk staging in the diff viewer
node test-render-all.mjs                   # every tab, diff overlay, compare and rebase dialogs
node test-render-location.mjs              # diff line selection, blame copy, clipboard text
```

@zeppeli777/idea-git README · npm install --no-save --prefix .tmp-test react@18.3.1 react-test-renderer@18.3.1：The Git engine also has a test adapter (`test-runner.mjs`) that redirects child output to files for sandboxed environments where piped stdio is blocked. The checks that mutate a repository always work on a copy, so the fixture survives a run.
